## Ctx.editBusinessStory() method

Edits a story previously posted on behalf of a managed business account.

**Signature:**

```typescript
editBusinessStory(businessConnectionId?: string | null, storyId?: number | null, content?: IStoryContent | null, options?: Parameters<Ctx[`api`][`editStory`]>[3] | null): Promise<grammy_types.Story>;
```

## Remarks

Business-connection-only like [Ctx.postBusinessStory()](./gramstax.ctx.postbusinessstory.md)<!-- -->: the same `business_connection_id` (with `can_manage_stories`<!-- -->) that posted the story is required. Content validation mirrors `postBusinessStory`<!-- -->; areas and captions are adjudicated by the Bot API — programmer errors always throw, never fall back.

why-not-base: explicit `businessConnectionId` (base `Context.editStory` uses the current update only) plus local-path `InputFile` resolution and fail-fast validation.

Observe-only send-error coverage (mirrors `renderDice`<!-- -->): failures are classified via `Ctx.classifySendError`<!-- -->, reported to `notifySendError`<!-- -->, and logged (`retryable` → `log.error`<!-- -->, `fallback-text` → `log.warn`<!-- -->). There is no degraded fallback content for stories, so after notify+log the original error is ALWAYS rethrown untouched.

}
